subject: geom_crossbar() : how to change width proportional to the sample size

messages.author: 2e3771ad0bc95bdb
messages.subject: geom_crossbar() : how to change width proportional to the sample size
parts:
Hi All,

I have a problem when I am using geom_crossbar() in ggplot2.

There is option "width=xx" in geom_crossbar() to fix the width of the bar. However, I want to make the width proportional to the sample size in each group. 

I found the original code for geom_crossbar()  https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/blob/master/R/geom-crossbar.r

But I am not familiar with modifying it in ggplot2 package.

Does anybody know how to modify it to make the width proportional to the sample size? Or is there any other way to do it?

Thanks very much!!
